data.title: Preview: Hoffenheim vs Sturm Graz - prediction, team news, lineups - Sports Mole
data.content:
## Team News

Hoffenheim are likely to continue with Ozan Kabak in defence, with the centre-back set to be joined by Koki Machida ahead of goalkeeper Oliver Baumann.

Nathan De Cat is the only midfielder set to miss out for the hosts, though he may not have been in the team ahead of Wouter Burger or Leon Avdullahu.

In the forward line, there is little reason to doubt the selection of Tim Lemperle, who may be supported by Fisnik Asllani, Alexander Prass and Adam Daghim. [...] As for Sturm Graz, central defender Paul-Friedrich Koller is a doubt due to illness, though he will be keen to battle through and make the XI next to Arjan Malic and Luis Balbo.

Valmir Matoshi may be asked to play in an advanced role behind forwards Simon Seidl and Oumar Diakite.
